一个上午的时间，李青山，李三奎，大壮，二壮，赵红旗，李青有，李青余一共七个人，都在忙活着伐树，锯木头，一个个汗流浃背，但是伐出来的木头根本不够，下午肯定还是要继续的。

“开饭了！”

王乃香拎着篮子走了过来，对着李青山等人喊了一声，一群人当即围了上来。

今天中午吃的是一只兔肉和一只野鸡肉，不过按照这么吃下去的话，家里存货估计也不多了，最多还能吃个两三顿，主要是李青山太需要肉来练习养生拳了。

李青山要是放开肚子吃，剩下的兔子和野鸡也就吃个一两天就没了。

这样下去可不行。

必须要想点办法，多整点肉，去电鱼就是最好的选择，但是现在光有电瓶不行，还需要其他的部件一起组成，你比如说这块电瓶他就是一个12v的电瓶，根本就不可能电鱼，电鱼是需要将电瓶提高300v后，使用高压脉冲去将鱼干晕了才行。

一旦被干晕了，水下的鱼就会翻白肚子，朝着水上漂，但要是电的时间久了，就会沉入水下。

除了电瓶之外，还需要变压器这些东西，这些东西都可以从收音机里面拆取出来，除了变压器还需要好几种东西，等到后世电鱼就是不允许的了，最后将两根金属杆子放在抄网上面，抄网朝着水下一探，鱼就直接翻上来了，顺带抄入小船内。

所以，现在的李青山除了电瓶之外，还需要一些零部件，这些东西去废品收购站，或者维修站点，有机会能寻到，不过自己身上没钱，还欠了供销社一点钱，还有李虎那里欠了三十块钱。

等到将木围子建起来后，自己就获取麝香，然后去换钱！

“哥……肉，肉，是肉啊……！”

小后山坡的临时木墩上，还散发出刚刚砍伐后草木的青香味，几个盘子放在上面，里面是香喷喷的鸡肉和兔肉，用了重油和八角花椒这些香料调味，香味四溢，油星子直接飘了一层，光是看着就解馋。

一群人就这么席地而坐，李青余颤抖着手臂缓缓夹起来一块肉，整个人都兴奋了。

多久了……！

多久了啊……！

距离自己上次吃肉，已经过去太久了，没想到今天竟然在李青山这个小鳖犊子这里吃到肉了。

爽啊……！

李青有见状，也是迫不及待拿起筷子就朝着盘子的肉夹了过去，脸上满是兴奋。

李青山这瘪犊子，虽然是个坏种，但运气真是好啊，竟然打了这么多野物，今天真是享福咯。

“啪啪……！”

然而。

还未等到李青有和李青余将筷子上的肉放入口中，便被李青山手中的筷子拍落，重新掉回了盘子里。

“李青山，你个瘪犊子干什么？”

“又皮痒痒了是不是？”

见到自己夹起来的肉掉了下去，李青有和李青余顿时怒目朝着李青山瞪了过去。

“呦，练练？”

李青山见状，顿时来了兴趣，放下手中碗筷，撸了撸袖子道。

“不，不练！”

李青有和李青余顿时浑身一颤，心中暗叫一声不好，竟然忘记现在的李青山，不是以前他们随便欺负的那个李青山了，稍微有些尴尬道。

“到饭点了！”

“你们两个不回家吃饭，在我这还待着干嘛呢？”李青山开口道。

“不是，李青山，我们给你干活，你不管饭啊？”

“怎么也得管饭啊！”

“就是，我们白给你干活？”

“没问你要工钱就不错了，吃你点肉怎么了？”

李青有和李青余顿时炸开了锅，目光不断朝着盘子里的鸡肉和兔肉望去，馋的直咽口水道。

“你们俩在赵木匠家里，管你们饭不？”李青山轻笑一声道。

李青有和李青余相互对视一眼，顿时不说话了，在他们师傅家，确实不管饭，按理来说是要管饭的，但当初为了学手艺，特意说了的，不要管饭，回家来吃，毕竟两张嘴也是挺厉害的，赵木匠家里可养活不起，人家还有一大家子呢。

“咋地，在我这里，就要管饭啊？”

“我这伐木，不也是学手艺吗？更何况，你们是赵木匠送过来的人情，不然赵木匠凭啥让你俩来给我白干活啊？”

“怎么拎不清呢！”

“去去去，赶紧回家吃去，别在这里烦我！”

李青山立刻赶人道：“对了，下午继续来帮忙，不来我告诉赵木匠。”

“切，小气！”

“真小气！”

李青有和李青余见状，也只能不甘心的朝着盘子里面看一眼，无奈的离开。

王乃香总共就送来一只鸡和一只兔子，自己几个人还不够吃呢，哪里有多余的给这俩货，每次想到当初在家里，这俩货欺负自己的时候，李青山都恨不得揍他们一顿，还给他们吃的呢。

娘的，这俩货当初偷吃东西，也经常诬陷自己。

搞得自己经常和李老屯反驳，因为经常和长辈拌嘴，自己这个二流子的称号，有一部分原因就是因为这个，一旦挂上了这个名声，娶媳妇都不好娶。

“乃香，你和嫂子，还有娘吃的啥？”李青山望着盘子里的菜，开口问道。

“我们也是吃的这个，留下来了一点。”王乃香语气温柔道。

“乃香，你回去告诉娘和嫂子，你们三个人重新炒只鸡或者兔子吃，不要不舍得吃，我要是回去发现鸡或者兔子没少，我就拎一只扔河里去。”

“这鸡和兔子的腿，头，翅膀都在这里面呢，你们怎么可能留下来了？”

李青山催促道：“赶紧回去吧，趁着时间还早，做好了还能赶上饭点！”

“乃香嫂子，以后你可就别骗我们山哥了，我们山哥可是聪明的很。”大壮笑着道。

吃过中午饭后，李青山等人准备休息一个半小时，然后继续开干。

争取今天忙活忙活，就把这木围子差不多搞定了。

李青有和李青余回到家后，刚好赶上饭点，李二奎望着自家两个儿子道：“咋了，你师傅骂你们了？”

当即。

李青有和李青余将今天的事情，一五一十说了，特别是在描述野鸡和野兔的时候，一个饭桌上的人，全部都暗自咽了口口水，眼神中流露出一抹精光。

那肉，光是想一想，就感觉香得很哦！

“爹，我能提个建议吗？”李大奎听到自己两个侄子的话后，也是有些嘴馋，目光朝着自家老爹望了过去道。

“说！”李老屯坐在主位上，点了点头。

“爹，咱们家天天吃素的，李青山他们家天天吃荤的，一到饭点做饭，好家伙，那香味全村人都能跟着沾光，这么下去可不行啊！”

“你说，村子里的人会怎么说？”

“三房离开了咱们家后，反而日子越过越好了，天天都吃上肉了，咱们家比不上李青山家，比不上李青山那小狼崽子。”

“爹，你说，你咽的下这口气不？”

李大奎开口问道。

“哼！”

李老屯一巴掌拍在桌子上，脸上满是怒色道：“一群狼崽子，真是能耐了，再怎么着，还不都是我生的？”

说完之后，有些心虚的朝着自家女人瞥了一眼。

“爹，咱们这样下去不行啊！”

“我看，要不咱们家也拿出一点钱，去乡里割点肉回来解解馋，我这身子也得补一补不是？”

李大奎目光朝着自己受伤的位置看了看，脸上夹杂着几分痛苦道。

“你说得对，咱们家啊，不能让李青山比下去！”

“待会啊，青书！”

“你来我这里拿两块钱，去乡里割肉去，咱们家要吃，就多吃点，到时候咱们把桌子搬出去，在门外吃。”

“让乡亲们看看，咱们老李家的日子。”

“好得很。”

李老屯一咬牙，开口道。

两块钱？

那可是足足能买四斤肉，逢年过节都没这个量，全家相互对视一眼后，瞬间热闹了起来，一个个面带喜色，眼前的玉米面子吃起来都香了。

“对了，爹，上次说把我娘家那个侄女介绍给李青山，还办不办的？”就在这时，李二奎的媳妇突然道。

“办什么办，李青山这小狼崽子也配？”李老屯气哼哼道。

“爷，我觉得这事情得办！”

李青书想了想后，突然开口道。

“咋？”

“李青山这小子也不用咱们催促了，肯定还要去老林子的，咱们再给他娶媳妇上的压力，还有必要吗？”

李老屯皱着眉头，开口问道。

“爷，有必要啊！”

“咱们可以恶心这小狼崽子啊！”

“这小狼崽子不是和王乃香走得近吗，那可是个小寡妇，勾人的小寡妇啊！”

“等到李青山和二婶侄女相亲在一起的消息传开后，咱们再让二婶侄女指认李青山和王乃香那小子在一块苟且，到时候，李青山这小子的名声一坏，从此以后就别想着娶大闺女了。”

In one morning, Li Qingshan, Li Sankui, Dazhuang, Erzhuang, Zhao Hongqi, Li Qingyou, and Li Qingyu, a total of seven people, were busy felling trees and sawing wood. They were sweating profusely, but the wood cut was not enough at all, and they would definitely continue in the afternoon.

"It's time to eat!"

Wang Naixiang came over with a basket and shouted to Li Qingshan and others, and a group of people immediately gathered around.

Today's lunch was a rabbit and a pheasant. However, if we continue to eat like this, we will probably not have much stock at home. We can only eat two or three meals at most. The main reason is that Li Qingshan needs meat so much to practice health-preserving boxing.

If Li Qingshan eats freely, the remaining rabbits and pheasants will only be eaten in a day or two.

This cannot continue.

We have to think of some way to make more meat, electrocuting fish is the best choice, but now the battery alone is not enough, it also needs other components. For example, this battery is a 12v battery, and it is impossible to electrofish. To electrofish, you need to increase the battery to 300v, and then use high-voltage pulses to stun the fish.

Once stunned, the fish underwater will turn their bellies white and float towards the water, but if the electricity is applied for a long time, they will sink underwater.

In addition to the battery, you also need things like a transformer, which can be removed from the radio. In addition to the transformer, you need several other things. In later generations, electric fish will no longer be allowed. Finally, two metal poles were placed on the dip net, and the dip net was pushed toward the water. The fish flipped up directly and were taken into the boat.

Therefore, in addition to batteries, Li Qingshan now also needs some parts. These things can be found at the scrap collection station or repair station if there is a chance. However, he has no money and still owes some money to the supply and marketing cooperative. He also owes 30 yuan to Li Hu.

After the wooden fence is built, get the musk yourself and exchange it for money!

"Brother...meat, meat, meat...!"

On the temporary wooden pier on the small back hillside, the green aroma of freshly cut vegetation was still exuding. Several plates were placed on it, which contained fragrant chicken and rabbit meat. They were seasoned with spices such as heavy oil and star anise pepper.

A group of people were sitting on the ground like this. Li Qingyu slowly picked up a piece of meat with his trembling arms, and his whole body was excited.

How long has it been...!

How long has it been...!

It's been too long since the last time I ate meat. I didn't expect to eat meat from a little turtle named Li Qingshan today.

So cool...!

When Li Qing saw this, he couldn't wait to pick up his chopsticks and move towards the meat on the plate, his face full of excitement.

Although Li Qingshan is a bad guy, he is really lucky. He managed to kill so many wild animals. He was really blessed today.

"Papa...!"

However.

Before Li Qingyou and Li Qingyu could put the meat on the chopsticks into their mouths, it was knocked off the chopsticks in Li Qingshan's hand and fell back onto the plate.

"Li Qingshan, what are you doing, you weakling?"

"It's itchy again, isn't it?"

Seeing that the meat they had picked up fell down, Li Qingyou and Li Qingyu immediately glared at Li Qingshan angrily.

"Hey, practice?"

When Li Qingshan saw this, he immediately became interested, put down the bowl and chopsticks in his hands, rolled up his sleeves and said.

"No, don't practice!"

Li Qingyou and Li Qingyu suddenly trembled and screamed in their hearts. They actually forgot that the current Li Qingshan was not the Li Qingshan they bullied casually before, and said with a little embarrassment.

"It's dinner time!"

"If you two don't go home for dinner, why are you staying here with me?" Li Qingshan asked.

"No, Li Qingshan, we work for you, but you don't care about the food?"

"You have to take care of the food no matter what!"

"That is, we work for you for free?"

"It's good that I didn't ask you for wages. What's wrong with eating your meat?"

Li Qingyou and Li Qingyu immediately started to explode. Their eyes kept looking at the chicken and rabbit on the plate, and they swallowed with greed.

"You two are at Carpenter Zhao's house. Do you care about your food?" Li Qingshan chuckled.

Li Qingyou and Li Qingyu looked at each other and immediately stopped talking. In their master's house, they really didn't care about the food. Logically speaking, they had to take care of the food. However, in order to learn the craft, they specifically said not to take care of the food and come home to eat. After all, two mouths are quite powerful. Carpenter Zhao's family can't afford to support them. He has a large family.

"Why, do you have to take care of the food here?"

"Aren't I learning the craft of logging? What's more, you are a favor sent by Carpenter Zhao. Otherwise, why would Carpenter Zhao let you two work for me in vain?"

"Why can't I carry it clearly!"

"Go, go, go home and eat quickly, don't bother me here!"

Li Qingshan immediately rushed to help: "By the way, we will continue to help you in the afternoon. If you don't come, I will tell Carpenter Zhao."

"Tch, stingy!"

"How stingy!"

When Li Qingyou and Li Qingyu saw this, they could only glance at the plate unwillingly and left helplessly.

Wang Naixiang only sent a chicken and a rabbit in total. It was not enough for just a few of them. How could there be any extra for these two people? Every time he thought about the time when these two people bullied him at home, Li Qingshan wanted to beat them up and give them food.

Damn it, these two guys used to steal food and often framed themselves.

As a result, I often quarrel with Li Laotun because I often quarrel with my elders. Part of the reason why I am called a second-rate son is because of this. Once I have this reputation, it will be difficult to find a wife.

"Naixiang, what do you, sister-in-law, and mother have to eat?" Li Qingshan looked at the dishes on the plate and asked.

"We also ate this and left some behind." Wang Naixiang said in a gentle tone.

"Naixiang, go back and tell your mother and sister-in-law that the three of you fry some chicken or rabbits again, and don't be reluctant to eat them. If I go back and find that there are too many chickens or rabbits, I will take one and throw it into the river."

"The legs, heads, and wings of these chickens and rabbits are all here. How could you stay here?"

Li Qingshan urged: "Go back quickly, while it's still early, you can still make it in time for dinner!"

"Sister-in-law Naixiang, please don't lie to our brother Shan in the future. Our brother Shan is very smart." Da Zhuang said with a smile.

After lunch, Li Qingshan and others prepared to rest for an hour and a half before continuing to work.

Try to be busy today and almost finish this wooden fence.

After Li Qingyou and Li Qingyu returned home, they were just in time for dinner. Li Erkui looked at his two sons and said, "What's wrong? Did your master scold you?"

Immediately.

Li Qingyou and Li Qingyu talked about today's events in detail, especially when describing the pheasants and hares. Everyone at the dinner table swallowed secretly, with a glint in their eyes.

That meat, just thinking about it, feels so delicious!

"Dad, can I make a suggestion?" Li Dakui was a little greedy after hearing what his two nephews said, and looked at his father.

"Say!" Li Laotun sat on the main seat and nodded.

"Dad, our family eats vegetarian food every day, and Li Qingshan's family eats meat every day. When it's time to cook, my dear, the whole village can enjoy the smell. This can't go on like this!"

"What do you think the people in the village will say?"

"After Sanfang left our house, life got better and better. He ate meat every day. Our family is not as good as Li Qingshan's family, and not as good as Li Qingshan's little wolf cub."

"Dad, tell me, can you swallow this breath?"

Li Dakui asked.

"Hmph!"

Li Laotun slapped his hand on the table and said with an angry look on his face: "A bunch of wolf cubs are really capable. No matter what, they are all born to me?"

After finishing speaking, he glanced at his woman with a guilty conscience.

"Dad, we can't go on like this!"

"I think, how about our family spend some money and go to the countryside to cut some meat and come back to satisfy our hunger? I also need to replenish my health, right?"

Li Dakui looked at his injured position, with a hint of pain on his face.

"You are right, our family cannot let Li Qingshan compete with us!"

"Later, Qingshu!"

"You come to me and get two yuan and go to the countryside to cut the meat. If our family wants to eat, we can eat more. Then we will move the table out and eat outside the door."

"Let the villagers see the life of our old Li family."

"Very good."

Li Laotun gritted his teeth and said.

Two dollars?

That is enough to buy four kilograms of meat, which is not an amount during the holidays. After the whole family looked at each other, they immediately became lively, everyone looked happy, and the cornmeal in front of them tasted delicious.

"By the way, Dad, last time I asked you to introduce my niece to Li Qingshan, are you still going to do it?" At this moment, Li Erkui's wife suddenly said.

"What should I do? Li Qingshan is worthy of this little wolf cub?" Li Laotun said angrily.

"Master, I think this matter must be done!"

After Li Qingshu thought for a while, he suddenly spoke.

"What?"

"This kid Li Qingshan doesn't need us to push him. He will definitely go to Laolinzi. Is it necessary for us to put more pressure on him to find a wife?"

Li Laotun frowned and asked.

"Master, it's necessary!"

"We can disgust this little wolf bastard!"

"Isn't this little wolf cub close to Wang Naixiang? She's a little widow, a seductive little widow!"

"After the news spreads that Li Qingshan and the second aunt and niece are on a blind date, we will let the second aunt and niece point out that Li Qingshan and Wang Naixiang are living together. By then, Li Qingshan's reputation will be ruined, and he will no longer think about marrying the eldest daughter."
